name: gaussian-action-boundary-diagnostic-2026-10-23
hypothesis: Hard-clipping native Gaussian samples may place substantial probability at executed action boundaries. Measure conditional mass without fitting before proposing a support-aware policy. Boundary mass is not proof of poor returns or a training-causal explanation.
untrained: Pinned full64 control seed11 initialization from recurrent_capacity_v1; exact policy tensor and RNG proof, default zero decay/eps1e-5

selection.symbols: All111 source training episodes, sorted by symbol
selection.account_path: Fixed [0,0,0,0] action after each observation keeps the account flat; do not execute policy actions or rank symbols/dates by outcomes
selection.memory: Independent actor hidden/cell state reset for each symbol/model and carried over32 observations
selection.normalization: Original frozen seven-field training-only normalizer, no refit or clipping

measurements: Exact Normal marginal probabilities below-1/above+1 for each action
Joint any-component boundary mass from conditional diagonal independence
Mean/range of Gaussian means and standard deviations

constraints.interpretation: Conditional distribution diagnostic on fixed training prefixes, not observed historical rollout clipping frequency or an economic return result
constraints.next: Review mechanism and installed-library bounded-support implementation before a separate fixed matched training protocol; no automatic training allocation, no reopening closed families
